findings.title: Forms send customer data without encryption
findings.detail: Contact or login forms submit over plain http://.
findings.fix: Serve and submit every form over HTTPS.
findings.impact: Names, phone numbers and messages your customers type can be read by anyone on the network.

findings.title: Site is not served over HTTPS
findings.detail: Browsers mark the site 'Not secure' and Google uses HTTPS as a ranking signal.
findings.fix: Install an SSL certificate and 301-redirect all http:// URLs to https://.

findings.title: No clear call to action on the homepage
findings.detail: Visitors don't know the next step, so traffic doesn't become leads.
findings.fix: Add a prominent 'Book a consultation' / 'Get a free quote' button above the fold.

findings.title: Outdated, publicly visible CMS version (WordPress 5.8.2)
findings.detail: The site runs an old content-management system version and advertises it in the page code.
findings.fix: Upgrade core and plugins, remove the generator tag.
findings.impact: Old CMS versions are the #1 way small-business sites get hacked and blacklisted by Google.

findings.title: Outdated JavaScript libraries: jQuery 1.12.4
findings.detail: These versions have publicly known security vulnerabilities.
findings.fix: Upgrade or remove the libraries.
findings.impact: Known vulnerabilities in old libraries let attackers run code in your visitors' browsers.

findings.title: No reviews or testimonials on the site
findings.detail: We found no customer reviews, testimonials or review widgets on any page we checked.
findings.fix: Embed Google reviews and add testimonials near every call to action.
findings.impact: Most people read reviews before contacting a local business. Without them, many leave to check a competitor.

findings.title: No XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml
findings.detail: Google discovers new and updated pages more slowly without a sitemap.
findings.fix: Generate an XML sitemap and submit it in Google Search Console.

findings.title: Built with outdated web technology (<font> tags, <center> tags, 1990s-style HTML attributes)
findings.detail: The page uses HTML features that were retired over a decade ago.
findings.fix: Rebuild on modern HTML/CSS.
findings.impact: The site looks dated, renders inconsistently on new devices, and can't be patched into a modern design.

findings.title: Page layout is built with tables
findings.detail: The design uses HTML tables for layout, a technique from the early 2000s.
findings.fix: Rebuild with CSS grid/flexbox.
findings.impact: Table layouts can't adapt to phones, so the site can't be made mobile-friendly without a rebuild.

findings.title: Form fields without labels
findings.detail: Screen readers can't tell blind visitors what to type in some form fields.
findings.fix: Add <label> elements to every field.
findings.impact: Missing form labels are one of the most cited problems in ADA website lawsuits.

findings.title: No LocalBusiness / Organization schema
findings.detail: Structured data helps Google show your hours, reviews and location in the map pack.
findings.fix: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD with name, address, phone, hours, geo and sameAs links.

findings.title: Very little readable text in the page HTML
findings.detail: If content only appears after JavaScript runs, many crawlers and AI tools see a blank page.
findings.fix: Server-render or pre-render the main content.

findings.title: No Content Security Policy
findings.detail: Nothing limits which scripts can run on the site.
findings.fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy header.
findings.impact: If a plugin or ad script is compromised, it can inject spam, redirects or card skimmers.

findings.title: No clickjacking protection
findings.detail: Any other website can load this site inside a hidden frame.
findings.fix: Add X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN or CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.impact: Attackers can trick visitors into clicking buttons on your site without knowing it.

findings.title: No privacy policy
findings.detail: The site collects visitor data (forms or tracking) without a privacy policy.
findings.fix: Publish a privacy policy and link it in the footer and next to forms.
findings.impact: Required by Google Ads, Meta ads and privacy laws, and its absence reduces trust.

findings.title: No way to book online
findings.detail: Visitors can't pick a time or request an appointment directly on the site.
findings.fix: Add an online booking or appointment-request flow.
findings.impact: People searching at night or on weekends can't book, so they book with whoever lets them.

findings.title: Lead forms ask for too much
findings.detail: Some forms have more than 6 fields.
findings.fix: Cut forms to name, phone/email and one question.
findings.impact: Every extra field lowers the number of people who finish the form.

findings.title: Homepage headline doesn't say what you do ("Welcome")
findings.detail: The main headline is generic and doesn't name the service, the area or the benefit.
findings.fix: Rewrite the hero headline: service + area + benefit.
findings.impact: Visitors decide in about 5 seconds whether they're in the right place.

findings.title: No robots.txt file
findings.detail: Search engines and AI crawlers have no crawl guidance.
findings.fix: Publish /robots.txt that allows crawling and points to the XML sitemap.

findings.title: Pages missing a meta description (2)
findings.detail: Google writes its own snippet, usually lowering click-through.
findings.fix: Write a 140-160 character description with a call to action.

findings.title: Thin content (under 300 words) (3)
findings.detail: Short pages rarely rank for competitive terms.
findings.fix: Expand key service pages to 600+ useful words, with FAQs.

findings.title: Images missing alt text (1)
findings.detail: Hurts accessibility and image search visibility.
findings.fix: Add short descriptive alt text to every meaningful image.

findings.title: Footer still says © 2018
findings.detail: The copyright year hasn't been updated in years.
findings.fix: Update the year (or render it dynamically).
findings.impact: Visitors read an old date as a sign the business may be closed or the site is neglected.

findings.title: Images aren't sized for phones
findings.detail: Every device downloads the same full-size images.
findings.fix: Use srcset/sizes and responsive image components.
findings.impact: Phones download far more data than they need, which makes the site slow on mobile.

findings.title: Links and buttons with no readable name
findings.detail: Icon-only links/buttons have no text a screen reader can announce.
findings.fix: Add aria-labels to icon links and buttons.
findings.impact: Blind visitors hear 'link, link, button' and can't navigate, which is a common ADA complaint.

findings.title: Zooming is disabled on phones
findings.detail: The site blocks pinch-to-zoom.
findings.fix: Remove user-scalable=no / maximum-scale=1.
findings.impact: Visitors with low vision can't enlarge text. This fails accessibility guidelines.

findings.title: Phone number is not click-to-call
findings.detail: Most local searches happen on mobile.
findings.fix: Wrap the number in a tel: link.

findings.title: No structured data at all
findings.detail: AI tools and Google rely on schema to understand services, FAQs and reviews.
findings.fix: Add Organization, Service and FAQPage schema.

findings.title: No favicon
findings.detail: Looks unfinished in browser tabs and Google results.
findings.fix: Add a favicon and apple-touch-icon.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.detail: Browsers may guess file types, which opens the door to some script attacks.
findings.fix: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
findings.impact: A small but easy-to-close security gap.

findings.title: Server software versions are public
findings.detail: The server announces exactly what it runs (server: SimpleHTTP/0.6 Python/3.13.18).
findings.fix: Hide version numbers in server config.
findings.impact: Attackers use these version numbers to find known exploits for your server.

findings.title: Tracking runs with no cookie notice
findings.detail: Analytics or ad pixels load without any cookie notice or consent option.
findings.fix: Add a consent banner wired to Google Consent Mode.
findings.impact: A growing legal risk under state privacy laws, and Google now limits ad data without consent.

findings.title: No trust signals
findings.detail: No licenses, certifications, awards, guarantees or 'years in business' anywhere on the site.
findings.fix: Add a trust bar under the hero.
findings.impact: Trust signals near the top of the page measurably raise the number of visitors who call.

findings.title: No chat or text option
findings.detail: Visitors can't message the business from the site.
findings.fix: Add web chat or text-us.
findings.impact: Many younger customers would rather text than call, and chat captures leads after hours.

findings.title: Most pages have no canonical tag
findings.detail: Duplicate URL variants may compete with each other.
findings.fix: Add a self-referencing rel=canonical on every page.

findings.title: No Open Graph tags
findings.detail: Links shared on Facebook, LinkedIn and iMessage show no image or proper title.
findings.fix: Add og:title, og:description and og:image.

findings.title: No modern image formats
findings.detail: Images use older JPG/PNG formats only.
findings.fix: Serve WebP/AVIF.
findings.impact: Modern formats are typically 25-50% smaller, so pages load noticeably faster.

findings.title: No page landmarks
findings.detail: The page has no <main> region, so keyboard and screen-reader users can't skip to content.
findings.fix: Use semantic header/nav/main/footer and a skip link.
findings.impact: Makes the site hard to use with assistive technology.

findings.title: No Google Map embedded
findings.detail: A map on the contact page reinforces your location.
findings.fix: Embed your Google Business Profile map.

findings.title: No language declared on <html>
findings.detail: Helps search engines serve the page to the right audience.
findings.fix: Add lang="en-US".

findings.title: No /llms.txt file
findings.detail: An emerging standard that tells AI assistants what your business does and which pages matter.
findings.fix: Publish /llms.txt with a summary of services, locations and key URLs.

rebuild_case: The problems aren't in one place: 4 of 8 areas score below 70 (Conversion & trust, Security & privacy, Technical SEO, Design & technology age). Fixing them one by one means touching almost every page and template.

The site is built on outdated foundations (retired HTML, a table-based layout, an outdated CMS, old JavaScript libraries). Patching old code usually costs more than building new, and the result still looks dated.
We found 6 security and privacy gaps. A modern build closes them by default instead of one at a time.
8 conversion problems mean visitors who find you are leaving without calling or booking. A new site can be designed around turning visitors into customers.
It's slow or awkward on phones, which is where most local customers search.
Accessibility gaps create ADA lawsuit risk. A new build can meet WCAG 2.1 AA from day one.
